sector_notes: Consumer staples remain the clearest positive 20-session sector proxy, with XLP up 2.75%, while utilities are up 1.81% and healthcare is nearly flat at 0.08%. Technology (XLK down 12.85%), semiconductors (SMH down 15.04%) and energy (XLE down 14.03%) remain the weakest groups over the same period, while SPY, QQQ and IWM are still down 5.63%, 8.59% and 4.06%, respectively. The Nov 23 rebound was sharp but did not repair the broader drawdowns, and Nov 24 premarket weakness in AI and semiconductor shares ahead of Wednesday's PCE release argues for selective defensive setups rather than chasing the prior session's gap.
